title: AIX每日精读
overview_zh: 2026 年 7 月 17 日的 AI × Chem 历史日报，收录 16 项精选。

items.title: How Well Can Frontier Large Language Models Generate Structures? High Quality Prediction of Molecular Geometries with Help from Fine-Tuning
items.abstract_or_text: The power of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led us to investigate how they might be fine-tuned for learning the "language of molecular geometry". The fine-tuning of the LLMs using Cartesian coordinates or Z-matrices provides an extremely simple method for accurately predicting equilibrium structures and diverse sets of conformers of small organic and drug-like molecules with excellent accuracy and outperforming specialized deep learning models. While the most common representation of molecular geometries are Cartesian coordinates performs adequately, we find that the inherent invariances and relational nature of geometries represented as Z-matrices provides a better grammar for LLM adaptation. Finally, we show that enhancing an LLMs capabilities for robust prediction of small molecule geometries still retains nearly all of its pre-trained language abilities by randomly mixing in small quantities of natural language prompt-response pairs into the fine-tuning.
items.summary_zh: 用微调 LLM 直接『写出』分子三维结构：以笛卡尔坐标或 Z-矩阵作为几何语言，在小分子与类药分子的平衡构象及构象集预测上超越专用深度学习模型，为 LLM 介入量子化学打开了一条极简路径。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 用微调 LLM 直接『写出』分子三维结构：以笛卡尔坐标或 Z-矩阵作为几何语言，在小分子与类药分子的平衡构象及构象集预测上超越专用深度学习模型，为 LLM 介入量子化学打开了一条极简路径。
items.author_line: Joseph M. Cavanagh, Jonathan B. Arnold, Giovanni Battista Alteri 等 5 人
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的强大能力促使我们研究如何通过微调使其学习“分子几何的语言”。使用笛卡尔坐标或 Z-矩阵对 LLM 进行微调，提供了一种极为简单的方法，能够以优异精度准确预测小分子有机物和类药分子的平衡结构及多样化构象集合，并优于专用深度学习模型。尽管分子几何最常用的表示——笛卡尔坐标——表现尚可，但我们发现，以 Z-矩阵表示的几何所固有的不变性与关系性质，为 LLM 适配提供了更好的语法。最后我们表明，通过在微调中随机混入少量自然语言提示–响应对，在增强 LLM 稳健预测小分子几何能力的同时，仍几乎完整保留其预训练语言能力。

items.title: RetroAgent: Harnessing LLMs to Search Over Structured Memory for Agentic Retrosynthesis Planning
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning seeks to decompose a target molecule into commercially available building blocks through a sequence of feasible reactions. The vast combinatorial search space makes this task challenging even for expert chemists. Traditional methods combine tree search with offline-trained value networks that score candidates in isolation, without reasoning about complete multi-step routes. Recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for this task, but relies on simple interfaces that limit exploration of the full search space. We introduce RetroAgent, an LLM agent that bridges symbolic search and neural reasoning through a harness with structured memory. Through memory and chemistry tools, the agent observes the full search state, including explored routes, available alternatives, and properties of intermediates, enabling informed decisions grounded in both global progress and domain knowledge. Experiments on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate that RetroAgent delivers strong performance and generalization.
items.summary_zh: RetroAgent 让 LLM 智能体在结构化记忆上搜索多步逆合成路线，能够推理整条路线而非孤立打分候选，是 agentic 合成规划方向的代表性新工作。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RetroAgent 让 LLM 智能体在结构化记忆上搜索多步逆合成路线，能够推理整条路线而非孤立打分候选，是 agentic 合成规划方向的代表性新工作。
items.author_line: Yanqiao Zhu, Jingru Gan, Xiaoqi Sun 等 11 人
items.abstract_zh: 多步逆合成规划旨在通过一系列可行反应将目标分子分解为可商购的砌块。巨大的组合搜索空间使该任务即便对专业化学家也具有挑战性。传统方法将树搜索与离线训练的价值网络相结合，后者孤立地给候选打分，而不对完整多步路线进行推理。近期工作将大语言模型（LLM）用于该任务，但依赖于简单接口，限制了对完整搜索空间的探索。我们提出 RetroAgent，一种通过配备结构化记忆的 harness 连接符号搜索与神经推理的 LLM 智能体。借助记忆与化学工具，该智能体观察完整搜索状态，包括已探索路线、可用备选方案以及中间体性质，从而基于全局进展与领域知识作出知情决策。在分布内与分布外基准上的实验表明，RetroAgent 具有强性能与泛化能力。

items.title: Machine Learning-Guided Engineering of High-Affinity Cross-Reactive Antibodies with Minimal Mutations
items.abstract_or_text: Antibodies raised against human targets often fail to recognize their animal orthologs, limiting preclinical evaluation in relevant models. We developed a Deep Mutational Scanning (DMS)-coupled deep learning strategy to engineer potent cross-reactive antibodies with minimal sequence divergence. Starting from C4, a fully human anti-PD-L1 antibody with weak recognition of murine PD-L1, DMS identified substitutions that improved binding to both human and mouse antigens. Conventional recombination of beneficial mutations generated highly cross-reactive antibodies but required 13 to 15 substitutions. To reduce this mutational burden, a deep learning model trained on DMS-derived sequence-binding data was used to identify minimal mutation combinations predicted to retain high affinity. This approach yielded variants carrying only 4 to 5 substitutions, with in vitro and cellular binding properties comparable to highly mutated antibodies. Epitope mapping, structural modeling and in vivo assessment further confirmed that these engineered antibodies retained PD-1/PD-L1 blockade and demonstrated therapeutic activity in a mouse tumor model.
items.summary_zh: DMS 深度突变扫描耦合深度学习，用最少突变把抗 PD-L1 抗体改造成人鼠交叉高亲和力，直接服务临床前动物模型评价，工程实用性很强。
items.why_it_matters_zh: DMS 深度突变扫描耦合深度学习，用最少突变把抗 PD-L1 抗体改造成人鼠交叉高亲和力，直接服务临床前动物模型评价，工程实用性很强。
items.author_line: Hugo, D., Grindel, A.-L., Thenier, F. 等 12 人
items.abstract_zh: 针对人源靶点产生的抗体常常无法识别其动物直系同源物，从而限制了在相关模型中的临床前评估。我们开发了一种将深度突变扫描（DMS）与深度学习相结合的策略，用以工程化序列差异最小的高效交叉反应抗体。以C4为起点——这是一种对鼠PD-L1识别较弱的全人源抗PD-L1抗体——DMS鉴定出可同时改善对人源和鼠源抗原结合的替换。将有益突变进行常规重组可产生高度交叉反应的抗体，但需要13至15个替换。为降低这一突变负担，我们用在DMS来源的序列–结合数据上训练的深度学习模型，识别预测可保持高亲和力的最小突变组合。该方法得到仅携带4至5个替换的变体，其体外和细胞结合性质与高度突变抗体相当。表位作图、结构建模和体内评估进一步证实，这些工程化抗体保留了PD-1/PD-L1阻断能力，并在小鼠肿瘤模型中表现出治疗活性。

items.title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO2, Li3PO4, and Perovskites
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate prediction of the Born effective charge (BEC) tensor is crucial for modeling materials under electric fields but remains computationally expensive. To bridge this gap, we present SevenNet-Polar, an equivariant graph neural network framework based on the SevenNet architecture for fast and accurate BEC predictions. Our BEC-only predictors can achieve an RMSE as low as 0.0043 e on ZrO2, Li3PO4, and perovskites, despite the presence of high-temperature (up to 2,000 K) and defect-laden training data. Our all-in-one multitask models for predicting energy, forces, stress, and BEC in ZrO2 and Li3PO4 achieve high accuracy with an RMSE of 1.0 meV/atom for energy, 12 meV/angstrom for forces, 0.05 GPa for stress, and 0.0029 e for BEC. BEC accuracy is not degraded by multitask training. Scaling analysis reveals distinct exponents for diagonal and off-diagonal BEC components, both of which exhibit less favorable scaling than energy, force and stress errors. SevenNet-Polar generalizes robustly when tested on scenarios containing structural environments absent from the training set, such as along nudged elastic band (NEB) trajectories or grain boundaries in ZrO2. Accelerated by FlashTP, SevenNet-Polar enables simulations containing up to 1.5 million atoms on multi-GPU supercomputers and up to approximately 15,000 atoms on a single consumer-grade GPU. This makes charge-aware molecular dynamics simulations under electric fields more accessible.
items.summary_zh: SevenNet-Polar：等变图神经网络一体化预测能量、力、应力与 Born 有效电荷，在 ZrO2、Li3PO4 与钙钛矿上 BEC 的 RMSE 低至 0.0043 e，是电场响应材料模拟的利器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: SevenNet-Polar：等变图神经网络一体化预测能量、力、应力与 Born 有效电荷，在 ZrO2、Li3PO4 与钙钛矿上 BEC 的 RMSE 低至 0.0043 e，是电场响应材料模拟的利器。
items.author_line: Anh Khoa Augustin Lu, Shungo Arai, Yutack Park 等 6 人
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测 Born 有效电荷（BEC）张量对于在电场下建模材料至关重要，但计算代价仍然高昂。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 SevenNet-Polar，一种基于 SevenNet 架构的等变图神经网络框架，用于快速、准确的 BEC 预测。尽管训练数据包含高温（高达 2,000 K）及含缺陷样本，我们的仅 BEC 预测器在 ZrO2、Li3PO4 和钙钛矿上可将 RMSE 低至 0.0043 e。用于预测 ZrO2 与 Li3PO4 中能量、力、应力和 BEC 的一体化多任务模型达到高精度：能量 RMSE 为 1.0 meV/atom，力为 12 meV/Å，应力为 0.05 GPa，BEC 为 0.0029 e。多任务训练并未降低 BEC 精度。标度分析揭示了对角与非对角 BEC 分量具有不同指数，二者的标度均不如能量、力与应力误差有利。当在训练集中缺失的结构环境上测试时——例如 ZrO2 中沿微扰弹性带（NEB）轨迹或晶界——SevenNet-Polar 仍能稳健泛化。在 FlashTP 加速下，SevenNet-Polar 可在多 GPU 超级计算机上模拟多达 150 万个原子，在单块消费级 GPU 上约达 15,000 个原子。这使电场下的电荷感知分子动力学模拟更易获得。

items.title: Excited-State Intramolecular Proton Transfer Dynamics with Neural Network Potentials and Nuclear Quantum Effects
items.abstract_or_text: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer is a prototypical ultrafast process that forms the foundation for many chemical and biological phenomena and is highly sensitive to changes in the underlying potential energy landscape. Here, we develop neural network potentials for 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline that describe ground- and excited-state dynamics with near ab initio accuracy. These neural network potentials enable efficient sampling of the proton transfer coordinate and incorporation of nuclear quantum effects through path-integral molecular dynamics. The free energy profiles show that excited-state intramolecular proton transfer proceeds on a largely barrierless excited-state surface, with nuclear quantum effects reducing and smoothing the residual barrier. Non-equilibrium simulations yield an average proton transfer time of ~11.4 fs for quantum hydrogen, consistent with experiment, and reveal a clear isotope effect, with slower dynamics for deuterium and classical nuclei. Mechanistic analysis identifies transient proton donor–acceptor contraction as the key enabling coordinate, while the proton crosses the midpoint prior to reaching the minimum of this coordinate, indicating a dynamically driven transfer. Subtle changes in the conjugated backbone precede proton transfer, reflecting early electronic reorganization and coherent coupling between proton motion and backbone vibrations. Bond-length alternation and vibrational coherence analysis reveal isotope-dependent coherence loss, with deuteration producing stronger damping and more localized proton/backbone dynamics relative to hydrogen. These results establish neural network potential-based approaches as an effective framework for simulating excited-state proton transfer with explicit nuclear quantum effects.
items.summary_zh: 为 10-HBQ 构建近 ab initio 精度的基态/激发态神经网络势，并结合路径积分分子动力学纳入核量子效应，定量刻画激发态分子内质子转移的自由能图景。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为 10-HBQ 构建近 ab initio 精度的基态/激发态神经网络势，并结合路径积分分子动力学纳入核量子效应，定量刻画激发态分子内质子转移的自由能图景。
items.author_line: Axel Gomez, Amke Nimmrich, Victor M. Freixas 等 7 人
items.abstract_zh: 激发态分子内质子转移是一种典型的超快过程，构成许多化学与生物现象的基础，并对底层势能面的变化高度敏感。本文为 10-羟基苯并[h]喹啉发展了神经网络势，以接近从头算的精度描述基态与激发态动力学。这些神经网络势使得质子转移坐标的高效采样以及通过路径积分分子动力学纳入核量子效应成为可能。自由能曲线表明，激发态分子内质子转移在基本无垒的激发态势能面上进行，核量子效应降低并平滑了残余能垒。非平衡模拟给出量子氢的平均质子转移时间约为 11.4 fs，与实验一致，并揭示了明显的同位素效应：氘和经典核的动力学更慢。机制分析确定瞬时的质子供体–受体收缩为关键促成坐标，而质子在该坐标达到最小值之前已越过中点，表明这是动力学驱动的转移。共轭骨架的细微变化先于质子转移，反映早期电子重组以及质子运动与骨架振动之间的相干耦合。键长交替与振动相干分析揭示了同位素依赖的相干性丧失：相对氢而言，氘代产生更强阻尼以及更局域化的质子/骨架动力学。这些结果确立了基于神经网络势的方法作为在显式核量子效应下模拟激发态质子转移的有效框架。

items.title: Implementations of Quantum and Classical Topology-Aligned Architectures for Molecular Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: For low-data and resource-constrained regimes typical of quantum chemistry, parameter-efficient learning is a key objective. Here, we propose a topology-aligned inductive bias in which the model architecture mirrors the molecular bond graph: atoms map to a fixed register of computational units, and bonds determine which pairs interact through shared learnable parameters. This principle is instantiated in two architectures: a variational quantum circuit (Iso-QGNN), and a parameter-matched classical message-passing model (Iso-CGNN). The models are benchmarked on HOMO-LUMO and dipole moment binary classification tasks over the QM9 benchmark. With 64 trainable parameters, the implementations achieve test AUCs of approximately 0.88 (quantum) and 0.91 (classical) on the gap task, and close to 0.78 (both) on the dipole task. The models reach 90% of asymptotic performance within about 250 training molecules and gradient norms remain stable throughout training. These results indicate that the topology-aligned inductive bias is the active ingredient driving parameter efficiency at QM9 scale, with implications for matched-baseline benchmarking in quantum machine learning.
items.summary_zh: 提出『拓扑对齐』归纳偏置：让模型结构镜像分子键图，分别实例化为变分量子线路 Iso-QGNN 与参数对齐的经典消息传递网络，面向量子化学典型的低数据场景。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提出『拓扑对齐』归纳偏置：让模型结构镜像分子键图，分别实例化为变分量子线路 Iso-QGNN 与参数对齐的经典消息传递网络，面向量子化学典型的低数据场景。
items.author_line: James T. Pegg, Hubert Okadome Valencia, Ronin Wu
items.abstract_zh: 在量子化学典型的低数据、资源受限场景中，参数高效学习是一项关键目标。本文提出一种拓扑对齐的归纳偏置，使模型架构镜像分子键合图：原子映射到固定的计算单元寄存器，键决定哪些对通过共享可学习参数发生相互作用。该原则实例化为两种架构：变分量子电路（Iso-QGNN），以及参数匹配的经典消息传递模型（Iso-CGNN）。模型在 QM9 基准上针对 HOMO-LUMO 与偶极矩二分类任务进行评测。在仅有 64 个可训练参数的情况下，实现方式在能隙任务上分别达到约 0.88（量子）和 0.91（经典）的测试 AUC，在偶极任务上两者均接近 0.78。模型在约 250 个训练分子内即可达到渐近性能的 90%，且训练全程梯度范数保持稳定。这些结果表明，拓扑对齐的归纳偏置是在 QM9 尺度上驱动参数效率的关键因素，对量子机器学习中的匹配基线评测具有启示。

items.title: Accelerated descriptor-free path sampling for protein-ligand binding kinetics
items.abstract_or_text: The kinetics of protein-ligand binding systems are increasingly recognized as a key determinant of drug efficacy, yet remain far harder to compute than binding affinities. Existing kinetics methods either bias the dynamics along a collective variable (CV), demanding careful system-specific CV design, or use path sampling, which keeps the dynamics unbiased but can struggle to converge rates out of deep free-energy wells and often relies on hand-engineered descriptors. By combining the `best of both worlds', we propose a method to compute accurate kinetics for general ligand-unbinding problems at modest computational expense and minimal fine tuning, building on the AI for Molecular Mechanism Discovery (AIMMD) path sampling framework. To avoid the need for feature engineering, we opt for modelling the committor with a single descriptor-free, equivariant graph neural network shared across all systems. We also partially flatten deep bound-state wells with a static, basin-restricted bias potential. This improves convergence by lifting the path sampling state boundary out of regions, where the committor is hard to learn, while leaving the reactive region strictly unbiased. Across host-guest and protein-ligand systems spanning roughly 17 orders of magnitude in residence time, the method robustly recovers rates in line with reference and experimental values. Simultaneously, and without further sampling, it also reconstructs the underlying unbinding mechanisms. We additionally find that accurate rates do not require globally accurate committor models, allowing for efficient kinetics estimation even in a low-data training regime. Requiring little system-specific setup, our approach offers an efficient and broadly generalizable route to binding kinetics, and its shared committor architecture lays crucial groundwork for probing structure-kinetics relationships across ligand series in drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 融合集体变量偏置与路径采样之长，无需手工描述符即可计算一般配体解离动力学，直指『结合速率远比亲和力难算』这一药物发现痛点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 融合集体变量偏置与路径采样之长，无需手工描述符即可计算一般配体解离动力学，直指『结合速率远比亲和力难算』这一药物发现痛点。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白–配体结合体系的动力学日益被认为是药效的关键决定因素，但其计算难度远高于结合亲和力。现有动力学方法要么沿集体变量（CV）对动力学施加偏置，需要精心的体系特异性 CV 设计；要么采用路径采样，虽保持动力学无偏，但难以从深自由能阱中收敛速率，且往往依赖手工设计的描述符。通过结合“两者之长”，我们基于分子机制发现人工智能（AIMMD）路径采样框架，提出一种方法，能以适中计算代价和极少微调，为一般配体解离问题计算准确动力学。为避免特征工程需求，我们选择用一个跨所有体系共享的、无描述符的等变图神经网络来建模提交子（committor）。我们还用静态、盆地受限的偏置势部分抹平深结合态阱。这通过将路径采样状态边界抬升出提交子难以学习的区域来改善收敛，同时使反应区保持严格无偏。在驻留时间跨越约 17 个数量级的主客体与蛋白–配体体系中，该方法稳健地恢复了与参考值和实验值一致的速率。同时，无需额外采样即可重建底层解离机制。我们还发现，准确速率并不需要全局准确的提交子模型，从而即使在低数据训练体制下也能高效估计动力学。本方法几乎无需体系特异性设置，为结合动力学提供了一条高效且广泛可泛化的路径，其共享提交子架构为在药物发现中跨配体系列探究结构–动力学关系奠定了关键基础。

items.title: Full-data accuracy with fewer labels for training and fine-tuning machine-learning force fields
items.abstract_or_text: Machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) are reliable only near their training distribution, making efficient construction of diverse training sets a major bottleneck for both train-from-scratch and foundation fine-tuning workflows. Active learning can reduce this cost, but standard model-committee uncertainty is impractical for foundation MLFFs because each committee member requires a separate fine-tuning run. We present an active-learning workflow based on last-layer-projection regression (LLPR), a forward-pass-cheap per-configuration uncertainty estimator. Across molecular, condensed-phase, and electrolyte systems, LLPR identifies compact, high-value training sets that recover full-data accuracy using only a small fraction of electronic-structure labels. In foundation-model fine-tuning, LLPR-selected configurations reach the full-pool fine-tuning ceiling with substantially fewer labels than random selection. In iterative electrolyte fine-tuning, LLPR detects unphysical local coordination before DFT labelling, provides an absolute force-error threshold, and enables automatic termination of the learning loop. The resulting models reproduce reference density and ion-coordination structure, providing a scalable uncertainty-quantification strategy across MLFF training regimes.
items.summary_zh: 系统研究机器学习力场训练中的标签效率，给出以更少标注达到全数据精度的策略，对降低 DFT 标注成本有直接参考价值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 系统研究机器学习力场训练中的标签效率，给出以更少标注达到全数据精度的策略，对降低 DFT 标注成本有直接参考价值。
items.author_line: Sheng Bi, Yi-Ze Wang, Jun Cheng
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习力场（MLFF）仅在训练分布附近可靠，因此高效构建多样化训练集成为从零训练与基础模型微调两类工作流的主要瓶颈。主动学习可降低这一成本，但标准的模型委员会不确定性对基础 MLFF 并不实用，因为每个委员会成员都需要单独的微调运行。我们提出一种基于末层投影回归（LLPR）的主动学习工作流，这是一种前向传播开销低廉的逐构型不确定性估计器。在分子、凝聚相与电解质体系中，LLPR 能识别紧凑、高价值的训练集，仅用一小部分电子结构标签即可恢复全数据精度。在基础模型微调中，LLPR 选出的构型以远少于随机选择的标签数达到全池微调上限。在迭代式电解质微调中，LLPR 能在 DFT 标注之前检出非物理的局部配位，提供绝对力误差阈值，并实现学习循环的自动终止。所得模型可复现参考密度与离子配位结构，为跨 MLFF 训练体制提供了可扩展的不确定性量化策略。

items.title: Medea: An AI agent for therapeutic reasoning across biological contexts
items.abstract_or_text: Therapeutic hypotheses can transfer across diseases but their relevance depends on biological context. The same target, perturbation, or treatment can produce different effects across cell types, disease states, genetic backgrounds, and patients. Therapeutic reasoning therefore requires methods that preserve context, test when evidence supports transfer, and identify where context-specific effects limit it. Although AI agents can perform therapeutic analyses, existing systems often fail to preserve biological context over long workflows, verify intermediate computational steps, or reconcile conflicting evidence across datasets and literature. Here, we present Medea, an AI agent for therapeutic reasoning across biological contexts. Medea executes multi-step analyses using biological tools, machine learning models, and literature retrieval while enforcing verification during planning, execution, and evidence synthesis. We evaluate Medea across 5,673 open-ended analyses in three domains: cell type specific therapeutic target nomination in five diseases and 29 cell types, synthetic lethality prediction in 7 cancer cell lines, and immunotherapy response prediction from multimodal patient profiles. Using a previously unpublished epistatic miniarray profiling screen performed under two DNA-damaging treatments, we evaluate Medea on predicting synthetic lethality among 238,046 gene-gene pairs in yeast. Medea accurately predicts these experimentally measured synthetic lethal interactions, indicating that its performance reflects biological relevance rather than information leakage from benchmark datasets. Across these evaluations, Medea improves performance over large language models, reasoning models, biomedical agents, and specialized machine learning models while maintaining low failure rates and calibrated abstention. These results show that verifiable AI agents can perform therapeutic analyses across biological contexts.
items.summary_zh: Medea：面向治疗推理的 AI 智能体，强调在长流程中保留生物学上下文并验证中间计算步骤，瞄准『同一靶点在不同情境效应不同』的转化医学核心难题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Medea：面向治疗推理的 AI 智能体，强调在长流程中保留生物学上下文并验证中间计算步骤，瞄准『同一靶点在不同情境效应不同』的转化医学核心难题。
items.author_line: Sui, P., Li, M., Munson, B. P. 等 12 人
items.abstract_zh: 治疗假说可跨疾病迁移，但其相关性取决于生物学情境。同一靶点、扰动或治疗在不同细胞类型、疾病状态、遗传背景与患者中可产生不同效应。因此治疗推理需要能够保持情境、检验证据何时支持迁移、并识别情境特异性效应在何处限制迁移的方法。尽管 AI 智能体能够执行治疗分析，现有系统往往无法在长工作流中保持生物学情境、验证中间计算步骤，或调和数据集与文献间的冲突证据。本文提出 Medea，一种跨生物学情境进行治疗推理的 AI 智能体。Medea 使用生物学工具、机器学习模型与文献检索执行多步分析，同时在规划、执行与证据综合过程中强制验证。我们在三个领域的 5,673 项开放式分析中评估 Medea：五种疾病与 29 种细胞类型中的细胞类型特异性治疗靶点提名、7 种癌细胞系中的合成致死预测，以及从多模态患者画像预测免疫治疗响应。利用先前未发表的、在两种 DNA 损伤处理下进行的上位性微阵列分析筛选，我们评估 Medea 对酵母中 238,046 个基因–基因对合成致死的预测。Medea 准确预测了这些实验测定的合成致死相互作用，表明其性能反映生物学相关性，而非来自基准数据集的信息泄漏。在这些评估中，Medea 相对大语言模型、推理模型、生物医学智能体与专用机器学习模型提升了性能，同时保持低失败率与校准的弃权。这些结果表明，可验证的 AI 智能体能够跨生物学情境执行治疗分析。

items.title: AI-driven design of a cost-effective synthetic route to malaria drug Ganaplacide
items.abstract_or_text: Malaria is a deadly infectious disease that disproportionately affects third-world countries. Ganaplacide is a drug candidate that is highly effective against malaria, but no affordable way to produce it exists yet. Here we show how we used a combination of AI-driven design and expert chemistry knowledge to develop a novel synthetic route to ganaplacide. The AI retrosynthesis algorithm suggested a non-evident two-steps synthesis of the imidazolopiperazine core of the molecule from benzyl-protected dimethylpiperazinone through a strategic thioimidate intermediate. We also present the Synthetic Confidence Score, which assesses the level of risk associated with a given retrosynthetic disconnection and allows balancing creativity and reliability. The synergy between AI creativity, metrics such as the Synthetic Confidence Score and expert chemist knowledge has the potential to unlock non-evident efficient routes for important molecules, when expert chemists alone have explored mainstream chemistry unsuccessfully.
items.summary_zh: AI 驱动设计出抗疟药 Ganaplacide 的低成本合成路线，是 AI 合成规划走向真实药物分子的落地案例。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI 驱动设计出抗疟药 Ganaplacide 的低成本合成路线，是 AI 合成规划走向真实药物分子的落地案例。
items.author_line: Fernando Huerta, Erik Leonhardt, Lianyan Xu 等 7 人
items.abstract_zh: 疟疾是一种致命传染病，对第三世界国家影响尤为严重。Ganaplacide 是一种对疟疾高效的候选药物，但尚无负担得起的生产方法。本文展示我们如何结合人工智能驱动的设计与专家化学知识，开发出一条通向 ganaplacide 的新型合成路线。人工智能逆合成算法提出了一条非显而易见的两步合成：由苄基保护的二甲基哌嗪酮经策略性硫代亚胺酸酯中间体构建分子的咪唑并哌嗪核心。我们还提出合成置信度评分（Synthetic Confidence Score），用于评估给定逆合成切断的风险水平，从而在创造性与可靠性之间取得平衡。当专家化学家单独探索主流化学未获成功时，人工智能的创造性、合成置信度评分等指标与专家化学家知识之间的协同，有望为重要分子解锁非显而易见的高效路线。

items.title: Beyond Global Drug-Likeness: The FamDLike Framework as a Target Family-specific Druglikeness Score
items.abstract_or_text: Drug-likeness is a central metric which is used to evaluate the physicochemical profile of small molecules either as a filter for virtual screening or, more recently, as a reward function in generative design tasks. Established scores such as ED are widely adopted for these purposes, although the ligands of different therapeutic target families occupy different regions of physicochemical space. Applying a single global drug-likeness criterion can therefore systematically reward some target classes while penalising others, narrowing the chemical space considered druglike in a way that may not reflect the actual requirements for a given project. In this work, we propose a target family specific drug-likeness approach, the amD ike framework, designed to distinguish target families more accurately than existing metrics and to explore family specific druglike regions of chemical space. This framework combines three complementary modelling paradigms: desirability functions, generali ed additive models and tree-based machine learning models that span the interpretability–flexibility spectrum. The three components can also be used independently, depending on whether interpretability or predictive flexibility is prioriti ed. The abilities of the proposed method have been tested on real-world use cases in computational medicinal chemistry: an independent set from DrugBank, library screening of Enamine and K I compounds, and de novo molecule generation via EI VE T4. The proposed approach therefore provides a more discriminative, interpretable and target-aware complement to existing drug-likeness scores, suitable for ranking in early discovery pipelines and as a reward function for generative chemistry. urthermore, a user-friendly web portal (https: huggingface.co spaces kochgroup amD ike) is available to obtain drug-likeness profiles of molecules.
items.summary_zh: 质疑单一全局类药性指标的系统性偏差：FamDLike 按靶点家族定制类药性打分，可同时用于虚拟筛选过滤与生成设计的奖励函数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 质疑单一全局类药性指标的系统性偏差：FamDLike 按靶点家族定制类药性打分，可同时用于虚拟筛选过滤与生成设计的奖励函数。
items.abstract_zh: 类药性是评估小分子理化轮廓的核心指标，既用作虚拟筛选过滤器，近来也用作生成式设计任务中的奖励函数。QED 等既有评分被广泛用于这些目的，但不同治疗靶标家族的配体占据理化空间的不同区域。因此，采用单一的全局类药性标准会系统性地奖励某些靶标类别而惩罚其他类别，从而以可能不符合特定项目实际需求的方式收窄被视为类药的化学空间。本研究提出一种靶标家族特异性类药性方法——FamDLike 框架，旨在比现有指标更准确地区分靶标家族，并探索家族特异性的类药化学空间区域。该框架结合三种互补的建模范式：合意度函数、广义加性模型和基于树的机器学习模型，覆盖可解释性–灵活性谱系。三个组分也可独立使用，取决于优先考虑可解释性还是预测灵活性。所提方法的能力已在计算药物化学的真实用例中测试：DrugBank 独立集、Enamine 和 K I 化合物的库筛选，以及通过 REINVENT4 进行的从头分子生成。因此，该方法为现有类药性评分提供了更具辨别力、可解释且靶标感知的补充，适用于早期发现管线中的排序以及作为生成化学的奖励函数。此外，可通过用户友好的网络门户（https://huggingface.co/spaces/kochgroup/FamDLike）获取分子的类药性轮廓。

items.title: Predicting Protein Electrostatics with Protein Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Ionization states play crucial roles in protein function, yet predicting protein pKa values remains a formidable challenge despite decades of research. Here we present KaMLESM2 and KaML-ESMC, neural network task heads built on ESM protein language models (pLMs) and trained on the PKAD-3r experimental dataset augmented via GAINES, a latent-space sampling strategy for addressing data scarcity. KaML-ESM2/ESMC significantly outperform current structure- and sequence-based approaches across four benchmarks, achieving root-mean-square errors of about 0.5 units across six titratable residue types in native proteins. Performance degradation on 89 buried engineered OBTRUDEs (iOnizable suBsTitutions foR bUrieD rEsidues) that lack evolutionary support (KaML-ESMC RMSE = 1.89) reveals a key limitation of the current framework, which may be overcome through supervised training. Based on these and other data presented in the work, we hypothesize that protein sequence, through its evolutionary context, encodes not only structure and function but indirectly also electrostatic characteristics. We applied KaML-ESM2 to the human proteome, demonstrating that predicted pKa values can potentially identify functional sites and infer catalytic mechanisms. We offer KaML, a sequence-based, end-to-end platform to support applications spanning biological exploration, drug design, protein engineering, and biomolecular simulation. Although additional research is needed, GAINES could offer a general framework for addressing data scarcity in machine learning approaches for protein-related problems.
items.summary_zh: KaML-ESM2/ESMC：在 ESM 蛋白语言模型上接任务头预测 pKa，辅以潜空间采样缓解数据稀缺，四个基准上 RMSE 约 0.5 个单位，显著超越现有结构与序列方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: KaML-ESM2/ESMC：在 ESM 蛋白语言模型上接任务头预测 pKa，辅以潜空间采样缓解数据稀缺，四个基准上 RMSE 约 0.5 个单位，显著超越现有结构与序列方法。
items.author_line: Shen, M., Dayhoff, G. W., Kortzak, D., Shen, J.
items.abstract_zh: 电离状态在蛋白质功能中起关键作用，但尽管研究已数十年，预测蛋白质 pKa 值仍是一项艰巨挑战。本文提出 KaMLESM2 与 KaML-ESMC，它们是构建于 ESM 蛋白质语言模型（pLM）之上的神经网络任务头，并在经 GAINES（一种用于应对数据稀缺的潜空间采样策略）增广的 PKAD-3r 实验数据集上训练。KaML-ESM2/ESMC 在四个基准上显著优于当前基于结构与基于序列的方法，在天然蛋白质的六种可滴定残基类型上均方根误差约为 0.5 个单位。在 89 个缺乏进化支持的埋藏工程化 OBTRUDE（iOnizable suBsTitutions foR bUrieD rEsidues，埋藏残基可电离取代）上的性能下降（KaML-ESMC RMSE = 1.89）揭示了当前框架的一个关键局限，这或许可通过监督学习加以克服。基于本文及其他所呈数据，我们假设蛋白质序列通过其进化背景不仅编码结构与功能，也间接编码静电特征。我们将 KaML-ESM2 应用于人类蛋白质组，表明预测的 pKa 值有可能识别功能位点并推断催化机制。我们提供 KaML，一个基于序列的端到端平台，以支持涵盖生物学探索、药物设计、蛋白质工程与生物分子模拟的应用。尽管仍需进一步研究，GAINES 或可成为应对蛋白质相关机器学习问题中数据稀缺的通用框架。

items.title: Generative design of programmable asymmetric β-barrel nanopores
items.abstract_or_text: Protein nanopores are powerful tools for molecular sensing, sequencing, and separation, but designing pores with programmable function remains challenging. Native homo-oligomeric transmembrane beta barrels (TMBs) are used for these applications, but their uniform lumens limit spatial resolution and analyte discrimination. Although monomeric TMBs can be designed using energy-based methods, these approaches remain highly manual and limited to structural design rather than function. Here, we present a generative AI framework for TMB design, with backbone and sequence design models trained on a curated distillation set. We characterized 48 designs spanning 0.7-1.5 nm in diameter, diverse lumen chemistries, and hydrophobic thicknesses. Crystal structures closely match the design models. We demonstrate that our method produces customizable nanopores for ion sensing, DNA translocation, and transport across polymer membranes.
items.summary_zh: 生成式设计可编程的非对称 β-桶纳米孔，突破天然同源寡聚体均匀孔腔的限制，面向分子传感、测序与分离应用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 生成式设计可编程的非对称 β-桶纳米孔，突破天然同源寡聚体均匀孔腔的限制，面向分子传感、测序与分离应用。
items.author_line: Philomin, A., Sonigra, R., Majumder, S. 等 17 人
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质纳米孔是分子传感、测序与分离的有力工具，但设计具有可编程功能的孔仍具挑战。天然同寡聚跨膜 β 桶（TMB）被用于这些应用，但其均一管腔限制了空间分辨率与分析物判别。尽管可用基于能量的方法设计单体 TMB，这些方法仍高度依赖人工，且限于结构设计而非功能。本文提出用于 TMB 设计的生成式 AI 框架，其骨架与序列设计模型在经整理的蒸馏集上训练。我们表征了 48 个设计，直径跨越 0.7–1.5 nm，管腔化学性质多样，疏水厚度各异。晶体结构与设计模型高度吻合。我们表明该方法可产生用于离子传感、DNA 转运以及跨聚合物膜运输的可定制纳米孔。

items.title: Characterising AlphaFold 3s ability to predict T cell antigen specificity
items.abstract_or_text: T cells are a key part of the adaptive immune system. Using their surface-bound T cell antigen receptors (TCRs), these cells scan peptides and other antigens pre-sented to them by major histocompatibility complex molecules (MHCs) on the sur-face of cells, searching for abnormalities. Although determining the map between TCRs and their target antigens is of vital importance for the design of safe and effective T cell-based vaccines and therapeutics, decoding these interactions is chal-lenging. Experimental methods are not scalable, and sequence-based computational methods have issues generalising to new antigens. The IMMREP25 benchmark of methods for predicting T cell antigen specificity showed that AlphaFold-based methods promise improved generalisation to novel antigens. However, the ability of structure prediction models to predict T cell antigen specificity has not been robustly evaluated previously. In this work, we characterise AlphaFolds ability to predict T cell antigen specificity. We created a pipeline for high-throughput pre-diction of TCR:peptide-MHC (pMHC) structures using AlphaFold that is > 100 fold faster than the default implementation and used it to benchmark AlphaFold 3 (AF3) and similar models at predicting T cell antigen specificity. We investigated the underlying correlates of AlphaFold-derived binding scores and found that the models predictive power is related to the positioning of TCRs over the pMHC and not chemical interactions. Furthermore, we refine the AlphaFold-derived binding scores by training a machine learning model we call the PAE Aggregator. We then investigate AF3s ability to uncover the clustering rules of TCR repertoires and re-capitulate mutational scanning experiments. These analyses show that AlphaFold3 clusters sequence-similar TCRs according to their binding mode and detects dis-rupting point mutations accurately. Our results highlight both the promise and the current limitations of structure-based approaches for predicting TCR specificity, guiding the development of more reliable immunological prediction methods.
items.summary_zh: 系统评测 AlphaFold 3 预测 T 细胞抗原特异性的能力边界，对 TCR 疫苗与细胞治疗设计有直接参考意义。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 系统评测 AlphaFold 3 预测 T 细胞抗原特异性的能力边界，对 TCR 疫苗与细胞治疗设计有直接参考意义。
items.author_line: McMaster, B., Elmoselhy, A., Ilievski, I. 等 8 人
items.abstract_zh: T 细胞是适应性免疫系统的关键组成部分。这些细胞利用其表面结合的 T 细胞抗原受体（TCR），扫描由细胞表面主要组织相容性复合体分子（MHC）呈递的肽及其他抗原，以搜寻异常。尽管确定 TCR 与其靶抗原之间的对应关系对于设计安全有效的基于 T 细胞的疫苗与疗法至关重要，解码这些相互作用仍具挑战。实验方法不可扩展，基于序列的计算方法在泛化到新抗原时存在问题。预测 T 细胞抗原特异性方法的 IMMREP25 基准表明，基于 AlphaFold 的方法有望改善对新抗原的泛化。然而，结构预测模型预测 T 细胞抗原特异性的能力此前尚未得到稳健评估。本工作刻画 AlphaFold 预测 T 细胞抗原特异性的能力。我们创建了一条使用 AlphaFold 高通量预测 TCR:peptide-MHC（pMHC）结构的流水线，速度比默认实现快 100 倍以上，并用其基准评测 AlphaFold 3（AF3）及类似模型预测 T 细胞抗原特异性的表现。我们研究了 AlphaFold 衍生结合分数的底层相关因素，发现模型的预测能力与 TCR 在 pMHC 上的定位有关，而非化学相互作用。此外，我们通过训练一个称为 PAE Aggregator 的机器学习模型来精炼 AlphaFold 衍生的结合分数。随后我们考察 AF3 揭示 TCR 受体库聚类规则以及复现突变扫描实验的能力。这些分析表明，AlphaFold 3 按结合模式对序列相似的 TCR 进行聚类，并能准确检测破坏性点突变。我们的结果同时凸显了基于结构的方法在预测 TCR 特异性方面的前景与当前局限，为开发更可靠的免疫学预测方法提供指引。

items.title: Openclatura–an Open-Source Nomenclature Framework for Rule-Based Molecule Naming
items.abstract_or_text: Naming molecules systematically remains an open challenge in cheminformatics. The reverse task—converting names to structure—has been largely solved for over a decade by OPSIN, yet no open-source tool performs the forward direction. Here we introduce Openclatura, which generates IUPAC names from molecular structures. The rule set was constructed by an agentic system that exhaustively enumerates naming rules, with each candidate name checked for structural round-trip consistency against OPSIN. Across three challenging benchmarks (QM9, PubChem, and ZINC22), Openclatura produces valid names for 98% of molecules, compared to 95% for the deep-learning baseline STOUT, while running on a single CPU core (40 times faster). We further present Robomoleculographer, an extension that generates natural-language descriptions of molecular graphs, bringing to chemistry what robocrystallographer offers to materials. Openclatura is fully deterministic and exposes an inspectable decision trace for every generated name.
items.summary_zh: Openclatura：首个开源的『结构 → IUPAC 命名』工具，规则集由智能体系统穷举构建并自动校验，补齐了 OPSIN 反向任务十余年来的空白。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Openclatura：首个开源的『结构 → IUPAC 命名』工具，规则集由智能体系统穷举构建并自动校验，补齐了 OPSIN 反向任务十余年来的空白。
items.author_line: Adrian Mirza, Kevin Maik Jablonka, Rostislav Fedorov
items.abstract_zh: 分子系统命名仍是化学信息学中的开放挑战。反向任务——将名称转换为结构——十多年来已基本由 OPSIN 解决，但尚无开源工具完成正向方向。本文介绍 Openclatura，它由分子结构生成 IUPAC 名称。规则集由一个智能体系统穷举枚举命名规则构建，每个候选名称均对照 OPSIN 检查结构往返一致性。在三个具有挑战性的基准（QM9、PubChem 和 ZINC22）上，Openclatura 为 98% 的分子生成有效名称，而深度学习基线 STOUT 为 95%，且运行于单 CPU 核心（快 40 倍）。我们进一步提出 Robomoleculographer，这一扩展可生成分子图的自然语言描述，为化学提供类似于 robocrystallographer 之于材料学的能力。Openclatura 完全确定性，并为每个生成的名称提供可检查的决策轨迹。

items.title: What Do Generative Models Learn About Adaptive Immune Receptor Repertoires? A Benchmark Study
items.abstract_or_text: Generative models are increasingly used to model adaptive immune receptor repertoire (AIRR) sequence distributions, promising to decode the sequence diversity shaping immune responses and accelerate the design of therapeutic antibodies and T-cell receptors. Yet it remains unclear whether these models produce biologically meaningful outputs or merely capture surface-level sequence statistics while missing features driven by receptor generation and selection. Rigorous evaluation is needed, but the field lacks established standards, as existing machine learning metrics do not all translate directly to the AIRR domain, given the complex structure of the data and the lack of biological ground truth. Consequently, researchers face difficulties in evaluating the models and selecting appropriate ones, which can critically affect downstream clinical applications. Here, we apply a suite of evaluation metrics tailored to AIRR sequence data and present a systematic comparison of popular generative model families proposed for the AIRR field, including variational autoencoders, long short-term memory networks, antibody language models, selection models, and simple statistical baselines. We focus specifically on the task of learning individual-specific immune receptor repertoires, a clinically relevant challenge with direct implications for personalized immunotherapy, disease monitoring, and vaccine response studies. By analyzing the sequences generated by each model, we identify memorization risks, innovation capabilities, and sensitivity to hyperparameter tuning. Taken together, these results advance the understanding of how current generative models reproduce the biology of individual immune repertoires and lay the groundwork for more principled model development and evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 一项基准研究追问：生成模型建模式免疫受体库时究竟学到了什么？结果显示其可能只抓住表面序列统计而遗漏受体生成的关键特征，为治疗性抗体/TCR 设计模型敲响警钟。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 一项基准研究追问：生成模型建模式免疫受体库时究竟学到了什么？结果显示其可能只抓住表面序列统计而遗漏受体生成的关键特征，为治疗性抗体/TCR 设计模型敲响警钟。
items.author_line: Würtzen, C., Mamica, M., Kanduri, C. 等 7 人
items.abstract_zh: 生成模型正越来越多地用于建模适应性免疫受体库（AIRR）的序列分布，有望解码塑造免疫应答的序列多样性，并加速治疗性抗体与T细胞受体的设计。然而，这些模型究竟产生了具有生物学意义的输出，还是仅仅捕捉了表层序列统计特征、而遗漏了由受体生成与选择驱动的特征，目前仍不清楚。严谨评估是必要的，但该领域缺乏既定标准：鉴于数据的复杂结构以及生物学真实标签的缺失，现有机器学习指标并不能全部直接迁移到AIRR领域。因此，研究者在评估模型并选择合适模型时面临困难，而这可能对下游临床应用产生关键影响。本文针对AIRR序列数据应用一套专门的评估指标，并对已提出用于AIRR领域的主流生成模型族进行系统比较，包括变分自编码器、长短期记忆网络、抗体语言模型、选择模型以及简单统计基线。我们特别聚焦于学习个体特异性免疫受体库这一任务——这是一项具有临床相关性的挑战，对个性化免疫治疗、疾病监测和疫苗应答研究具有直接影响。通过分析各模型生成的序列，我们识别了记忆风险、创新能力以及对超参数调优的敏感性。综合来看，这些结果推进了对当前生成模型如何再现个体免疫库生物学的理解，并为更有原则的模型开发与评估奠定了基础。
